drafts.title: The Serpent's Boudoir
drafts.reasoning: This scene captures the moment when Ursula transforms into a young blonde woman, setting up the reveal and establishing tension through dialogue.
drafts.scene: Inside the kitchen, which has been transported inside an underground Nazi bunker due to a mysterious temporal rift. Flashlights beam intermittently, casting shadows across the room. Miles and Owen remain tied to the counter in shock, while Charlie dances uncontrollably. Outside, the hobo observes with a mix of confusion and interest.

dialogue.line: Ah, Kyle! Finally something that works without my constant nagging!
Ursula, what did you do? Why are you screaming at me?
Sshh! Don't make waves until I’m done looking like this. Just… just pretend everything’s normal.
Normal? You look like you're auditioning for a shampoo commercial!
Shh, focus, boyo! Now go get me more coffee—er, hot water. And bring back Hitler.
Yes, ma’am. But why can’t we just hide it somehow?
Because hiding isn't working, is it? We need to make them see the new me first, then deal with whatever happens afterward.
Well, it's definitely making things harder on us both. How do you even expect him to react when he sees you?
He'll appreciate the improvement. He won't care about the details as long as his grand plans aren't interrupted by old age.
